responsibility: Implements builtin Rust #[derive(Ord)] and #[derive(PartialOrd)] expansion by synthesizing comparison-method AST impls in the macro-expansion layer. This file shares one DeriveOrd visitor for total and partial ordering, builds cmp or partial_cmp trait method signatures and impl blocks with the appropriate core::cmp trait paths and generic bounds, generates lexicographic field-by-field comparison expressions through nested match trees over Ordering::Equal or Option::Some(Ordering::Equal), handles enums by matching corresponding data-carrying variants and falling back to discriminant_value comparison for differing or fieldless variants, and emits a diagnostic when derive is requested on unions.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable derive logic declared in rust-derive-ord.h, implementing DeriveOrd methods that synthesize Ord/PartialOrd impl ASTs, recursive field-comparison matches, enum discriminant fallback handling, and union diagnostics.
